subject.title: Feature Request: Memory Trust Tagging by Source

question: What durable memory provenance and trust contract should OpenClaw support for default and plugin memory backends?
rationale: The remaining work changes persisted memory schema, plugin SDK/result contracts, retrieval security policy, operator config, and trusted-workflow defaults, so automation should not choose the permanent boundary.

options.title: Define native trust contract
options.body: Add source/review/influence/expiry metadata to the memory SDK, SQLite schema, and retrieval policy before implementation.

options.title: Plugin/API-first contract
options.body: Extend plugin hooks and memory SDK seams so external stores can enforce trust while core keeps a minimal default memory path.

options.title: Defer to external MCP
options.body: Document world-model-mcp or similar tools as optional workarounds and leave native memory trust enforcement out of OpenClaw for now.

recommendation.title: Define native trust contract
recommendation.body: Add source/review/influence/expiry metadata to the memory SDK, SQLite schema, and retrieval policy before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing signal for the memory host SDK, memory-core contract, config schema, and prior issue review context.
